title: Logging in immediately after registration succeeds with the same credentials
preconditions: A new account was just registered successfully (e.g. via TC-REGISTER-MALE-001) and the app has redirected to /login; the registered userName/password are known

test_data.userName: <the username used in the preceding successful registration>

steps: On the /login page, enter the just-registered userName
expected_result: Login succeeds and the user reaches an authenticated/logged-in state (the newly created account can actually authenticate - this is not just a UI redirect assumption).

title: API - login with freshly-registered credentials returns a token
preconditions: A new account was just registered via POST /api/user/ (e.g. the userName/password from TC-REGISTER-MALE-001)

body.userName: <the username used in the preceding successful registration>

steps: Send POST /api/login/ with the freshly-registered userName and correct password
expected_result: Response status is 200; response body contains a "token" field and a "userDetails" object with "userId" and "username" matching the registered account.

title: API - login with correct username but wrong password is rejected
preconditions: A new account was just registered via POST /api/user/ (e.g. the userName from TC-REGISTER-MALE-001)

body.userName: <the username used in the preceding successful registration>

steps: Send POST /api/login/ with the freshly-registered userName and an incorrect password
expected_result: Response status is 401; response body is empty.
